title: Create a sleep record
description: This verifies that an authenticated user can save a new sleep record and see it appear in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the sleep section link
Fill in the sleep hours field with a valid value
Fill in the sleep quality field with a valid value
Fill in the stress level field with a valid value
Fill in the nightmares field with a valid value
Fill in the notes field with a valid value
Fill in a valid date into the date field
Save the sleep record
Verify a new sleep record is displayed
